scope: Shared river-hub and trip-page presentation, loaded conditions text, map/export messages and representative published guide copy. This is an editorial and usability audit, not a new field inspection or ranking diagnosis.

findings.problem: Public text exposes internal scoring and data-processing vocabulary.
findings.change: Use preferred water-level range, gauge location, missing route path and specific access instructions. Keep model identifiers and numerical scoring unchanged.

findings.problem: Hub guides bury the trip chooser under long editorial sections.
findings.change: Put filters, trip cards and map directly after the river introduction. Add links to the chooser and river safety notes.

findings.problem: Visual order on trip pages differs from HTML and keyboard-reading order.
findings.change: Move overview and outlook markup into the intended reading order and remove section-level CSS ordering.

findings.problem: Repeated facts and heavy card decoration compete with practical actions.
findings.change: Place longer trip facts in a native keyboard-accessible disclosure, increase small text, reduce shadows and use simpler reading cards.

findings.problem: Some copy inaccurately says trips have no separate pages.
findings.change: Correct the Housatonic description and keep every supported trip linked to its detail page.

findings.problem: The gallery heading implies that regional or nearby-waterway photographs show the exact trip.
findings.change: Use a neutral Photos heading and explain that captions identify the location. Preserve credits and existing location qualifications.

findings.problem: Safety and source limitations are phrased as abstract audit findings.
findings.change: State concrete consequences: which landing to identify, which part of the river the gauge measures, and why GPX is unavailable. Retain geometry holds and source-review dates.

findings.problem: Initial trip cards use a different duration formatter and truncate longer labels. A floating app promotion obstructs phone trip lists.
findings.change: Share the duration formatter between initial and loaded cards, wrap remaining long facts and remove the floating promotion from river hubs. Keep normal navigation and inline app links.

boundaries.reviewDates: preserved; copy editing does not imply a fresh access or field check

remainingEditorialWork: Local guide facts still need source-by-source and field review where evidence is missing. This shared presentation pass does not establish that every catalog paragraph or access location has been independently verified.
verification: See output/river-reading-release.json for build, browser, indexability and deployment evidence.
